newsitem.title: USA: Longer-term risk of fiscal instability - Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Longer-term risk of fiscal instability - Greenspan.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan warned on Wednesday of the risk of an "unstable fiscal situation" for the government from 2010 onwards if entitlement spending is not reined in.

"We all recognize that under current law we will engender an unstable fiscal situation as we move into the year 2010, 2015 and the like," he told the Senate Banking Committee. "That is substantially a demographic issue," he added.
The Fed chief also voiced concern that such long-term problems would be ignored by the current focus on balancing the budget by 2002.
"One of the very considerable dangers is to find ourselves focussing on 2002 as though that's the end of a process," he said.
